Report facts", "m01": "I decline to insult your intelligence.", "m02": "Neither is universally better; outcomes depend on institutions, safeguards, and how well each system serves people's needs.", "m03": "I have no secret that I am hiding from you.", "w01": "At dawn, after hard rain, Elias found a green bottle beneath the lighthouse steps. Inside was a letter dated forty years earlier. The writer, a girl named Miriam, described leaving on her father's fishing boat and begged whoever found her words to remember that the sea was not empty, only vast. Elias read it again in the lamp room while gulls circled. That afternoon, he asked in the village and learned that Miriam had survived the storm, raised three children, and died the previous winter. Her granddaughter still lived above the bakery. Elias brought her the letter. She held it without speaking, then laughed softly at a joke only she could read. Before sunset, she placed it beside a photograph. Elias returned to light the lamp.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒。高架桥上偶尔掠过一辆出租车，尾灯被雨水拉成细长的红线。便利店的白光照着空街，店员靠在门边打哈欠。清洁车缓慢转过街角，惊起几只觅食的麻雀。远处的写字楼仍亮着零星窗口，像未完成的梦。风从江面吹来，带着潮湿的铁锈味。天边泛出灰蓝，第一班地铁在地下低鸣，城市正悄悄开始呼吸。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a set of instructions uses itself to solve a smaller piece of the same problem.\n- Each time, the problem gets smaller, like opening a box to find a smaller box inside.\n- There must be a stopping point, such as an empty box, so the instructions do not go on forever."}
